name: Spread
definition: Margin over or under an index which determines a rate.

SpreadRate.name: Spread Rate
SpreadRate.definition: Margin over or under an index which determines the interest rate of an interest bearing instrument.

BasisPointSpread.name: Basis Point Spread
BasisPointSpread.definition: Specifies the number of points to be added or substracted to the rate.

PriceOffset.name: Price Offset
PriceOffset.definition: Either a swap spread or spread to benchmark depending upon order type.  In case of a spread to benchmark, the price offset is expressed in terms of basis points relative to a benchmark - this can be a positive or a negative spread.  In case of a swap spread, the price offset is target spread for a swap.

BenchmarkSecurity.name: Benchmark Security
BenchmarkSecurity.definition: Security used as a reference to express the value of another security.

SecuritiesFinancing.name: Securities Financing
SecuritiesFinancing.definition: Securities financing process for which a repurchase spread is specified.

Index.name: Index
Index.definition: Index for which a spread is specified.

BenchmarkPrice.name: Benchmark Price
BenchmarkPrice.definition: Identifies the price of the benchmark security.

RelatedIndicationOfInterest.name: Related Indication Of Interest
RelatedIndicationOfInterest.definition: Indication of interest process for which a spread to benchmark is specified.

IndicationOfInterest.name: Indication Of Interest
IndicationOfInterest.definition: Indication of interest process for which a spread is specified.

RelatedInterest.name: Related Interest
RelatedInterest.definition: Interest calculation process for which a spread is provided.
